ChatGPT Ads: the setting + the ₹725 guide

Reel dekh ke aaye ho? Ye wahi dono cheezein hain. Pehle wo setting jo abhi off karni hai, phir ChatGPT pe apna ad chalane ka pura tareeka. No fluff.

Part 1

The setting (2 minutes)

Who sees ads

PlanPrice (India)Ads?
Free₹0Yes
Go₹399 / monthYes ("this plan may include ads")
Plus₹1,999 / monthNo
Pro₹10,699 / monthNo
Business / Enterprise / Edu—No

Ads show up below the answer, in a separate box marked Sponsored. ChatGPT ka jawab alag, ad alag. The ad does not change the answer.

The popup

"Personalize ads?"

Pehli baar ad milne se pehle ye popup aayega. Yes bola toh tumhari purani chats aur memory bhi ads ke liye use hongi. Na bolo. Baad mein bhi change kar sakte ho.

Turn it off

ChatGPT → Settings → Ad controls
phone pe: profile icon → Settings → Ad controls

Personalize ads
Use your ads history, interests, and past chats to make ads more relevant.
OFF
Past chats and memory
Use past conversations to make the ads you see more relevant.
OFF
Delete ads data
Clears your ads History and Interests. Your chats stay untouched.
TAP

What changes after this

  • Ads phir bhi dikhenge, but sirf current topic + rough location + device pe. Tumhari history pe nahi.
  • Advertisers ko sirf totals milte hain (views, clicks). Tumhari chats kabhi share nahi hoti.
  • Har ad tumhari history ka proof nahi hai. IRCTC wali kahani yaad rakho, but setting apni samjho.

Want zero ads? Plus, ₹1,999 / month, ya koi bhi paid plan Go se upar. Settings → Change plan to go ad-free.

Part 2

Run your own ad on ChatGPT (₹725 / day)

The basics

₹725minimum per day · ≈ ₹22,000 a month
10 croreweekly ChatGPT users in India (Feb 2026)
Sept 4self-serve Ads Manager open in India, 2026

Where: ads.openai.com (OpenAI Ads Manager). Ads reach Free and Go users only.

Who should try: dukaan, coaching, Instagram page, D2C brand, clinic, salon, SaaS. Anyone with a landing page and a clear answer to "when should my ad show?"

What a ChatGPT ad is made of

Your business nameSponsored

Description, up to 100 characters. One benefit + one proof.
PartLimitTip
Advertiser nameyour businessas people know you

Step by step

  1. Account

    Sign in at ads.openai.com with your OpenAI account → create an ad account → business name, country India, billing (card). Ads Manager shows Overview, Campaigns, Tools, Billing, Settings.

  2. Create campaign (Create → Create campaign)

    • Campaign name: Coaching – Class 10 Maths – Sept
    • Objective: Reach / Clicks / Conversions. Start with Clicks. Conversions needs a conversion event set up first.
    • Locations: include India, or just your city. Exclude nothing to begin.
    • Eligible platforms: leave default.
    • Daily budget: ₹725 minimum. Start there.

  3. Ad group

    • Ad group name: one per intent, e.g. Board exam prep
    • Bid strategy: Maximize results (default). Manual max bid only after you know your CPC.
    • Default ad destination URL: your landing page.
    • Landing page query parameters (optional): campaign_id={campaign_id}&ad_id={ad_id} so your analytics shows which ad brought the click.
    • Context hints: the important box. Describe in plain words when your ad should appear.
    CBSE class 10 maths coaching in Patna, board exam preparation, weak in algebra
handmade jute bags, eco-friendly gifting, corporate gifts under ₹500
IELTS preparation online, band 7, speaking practice

  4. Ad

    • Ad destination URL: same landing page, or a deeper one.
    • Title (≤ 50): Class 10 Maths: 90+ in boards, Patna batch
    • Description (≤ 100): Small batches, daily practice, first week free. 300+ students crossed 90 last year.
    • Ad image: one square PNG/JPG.
    • Check the Preview creative panel on the right: favicon + name + label on one row, title and description under it. Padhne mein ek second lage, that's the test.

  5. Review → launch

    Campaign summary → confirm budget → launch. Ads go through review before serving.

  6. Measure

    Overview → Performance trend: Spend · Impressions · Clicks · CPC. Set the range to 7d.

First-week playbook

  • Run 7 days at ₹725/day (≈ ₹5,000). Don't touch it for 3 days.
  • Day 4: check CPC and the landing page's conversions (WhatsApp messages, calls, sign-ups).
  • CPC fine but no conversions → landing page problem, not ad problem.
  • Impressions low → context hints too narrow. Add 2–3 more ways people phrase the need.
  • Day 7: kill or scale. Scaling = a second ad group with a different intent, not a bigger budget on the same one.

Common mistakes

  • Sending clicks to the homepage.
  • Context hints written like keywords instead of like a real question.
  • One ad for five different customers. One intent per ad group.
  • Budget all-India for a Patna coaching. Location = where you can actually serve.
  • Forgetting to check ads weekly. Set a Monday reminder.
